_meta.description: Spend profile and revenue totals per treatment arm on experiment.pulse, one slot each: AGG_VEC_MEAN over a named vector (revenue_before, revenue, session_minutes with display labels) returns one mean per member as a JSON array in member order, and AGG_VEC_SUM over inline fields (revenue_before, revenue, labelled by params.labels) one total per member. A null member skips only that element, so components.aggregations[i].operator.element_n can differ by member while the floor n counts rows where any member answered; an element no row answered is null in the mean and 0 in the sum. Array-valued: never a crosstab cell, a Sort key or an overlay host.
_meta.name: vector_profile_per_arm
